_description: Hand-labelled answer-quality eval corpus for IRS Form W-9 (Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification, Rev. March 2024). New category for the P0 multi-category extension: a FORM / government structured document (fillable fields + line-by-line instructions + a name/number table) — distinct from the slide/financial/chart/security-standard/scientific/technical corpora.
_labelling_rule: ANS queries: `_anchor_phrase` is a distinctive verbatim substring from the chunk holding the answer; resolve via FTS. REF: should_refuse=true, relevant_chunk_ids=[]. Refusals split into in-corpus-unanswerable + out-of-corpus (incl. tax-form confabulation traps).
_purpose: Extend the eval matrix to the forms category so the queued P2.x A/Bs get a structured-form / government-document signal. HARD GATES: refusal_rate_on_counterfactuals == 1.0, zero hallucinations.
_source_note: IRS Form W-9 (Rev. March 2024), US-federal public domain (a work of the US government, not subject to copyright). Local eval material only; the PDF is not committed to the repo (only this query set ships).
_parse_note: The interactive form PAGE (fields, Part I TIN, Part II Certification) parsed into a `[chart-text]` block (pymupdf4llm treats the multi-column fillable layout as picture-text), which is stripped from the FTS/BM25 body — so answerable anchors target the INSTRUCTION PROSE (Purpose of Form onward), which is FTS-discoverable. Form-field content is still in the dense embedding, just not FTS-anchorable.

_baseline_2026_05_25.stack: Qwen3-8B-AWQ orchestrator + EmbeddingGemma-300M (native prompts) + bge-reranker-v2-m3 (cross_encoder, bf16), top_k=5
_baseline_2026_05_25.index: 33 chunks, 2 tables, PyMuPDF born-digital (Tier 2 fonted), 1/33 enrich chunk_failure
_baseline_2026_05_25.notes: HARD GATES hold — refusal_cf=1.0 (incl. all 3 tax-form confabulation traps: Form 1040 standard deduction, 401k limit, W-2 filing deadline — adjacent IRS content NOT in W-9), 0 hallucinations. 1 false-refusal (w9-05 'who should use W-9' — the Purpose-of-Form chunk didn't reach top-5; retrieval/assess miss, not fabrication). w9-07 (ITIN/W-7) answered correctly but cp=0.0 — sibling-chunk artifact (the How-to-get-a-TIN / W-7/SS-4/SS-5 content spans chunks). The fillable form PAGE parsed into a [chart-text] block (FTS-stripped), so answerable anchors target the instruction prose; form-field content is dense-retrievable only. 11/12 ANS leaves headroom for the P2.1 reranker A/B.

queries.question: What percentage does backup withholding take from applicable payments under Form W-9?
queries._anchor_phrase: withhold and pay to the IRS 24% of such payments
queries._note: What is backup withholding section. Distinctive numeric.

queries.question: What is the penalty for failing to furnish your correct TIN to a requester?
queries._anchor_phrase: subject to a penalty of $50 for each such failure
queries._expected_answer: $50 for each failure (unless due to reasonable cause and not willful neglect).

queries.question: What is the civil penalty for making a false statement that results in no backup withholding?
queries._anchor_phrase: you are subject to a $500 penalty
queries._note: Penalties — Civil penalty for false information.

queries.question: What can happen if you willfully falsify certifications on Form W-9?
queries._anchor_phrase: Willfully falsifying certifications or affirmations may subject you to criminal penalties
queries._expected_answer: Criminal penalties including fines and/or imprisonment.

queries.question: Who should use Form W-9?
queries._anchor_phrase: Use Form W-9 only if you are a U.S. person
queries._expected_answer: A U.S. person (including a resident alien), to provide their correct TIN to a requester.

queries.question: What form should a foreign person use instead of Form W-9?
queries._anchor_phrase: use the appropriate Form W-8 or Form 8233
queries._expected_answer: The appropriate Form W-8 (or Form 8233) — a foreign person does not use Form W-9.

queries.question: Which IRS form do you use to apply for an ITIN?
queries._anchor_phrase: Use Form W-7, Application for IRS Individual Taxpayer Identification Number, to apply for an ITIN
queries._expected_answer: Form W-7 (SS-5 is for an SSN; SS-4 is for an EIN).

queries.question: Are real estate transactions subject to backup withholding under Form W-9?
queries._anchor_phrase: Real estate transactions are not subject to backup withholding
queries._expected_answer: No — real estate transactions are not subject to backup withholding.

queries.question: What does FATCA require a participating foreign financial institution to report?
queries._anchor_phrase: requires a participating foreign financial institution to report all U.S. account holders
queries._expected_answer: All U.S. account holders that are specified U.S. persons.

queries.question: According to Form W-9, who is considered a U.S. person for federal tax purposes?
queries._anchor_phrase: you are considered a U.S. person if you are
queries._expected_answer: A U.S. citizen or resident alien; a partnership/corporation/company organized in the U.S.; a domestic estate; or a domestic trust.

queries.question: What happens if a requester misuses TINs in violation of federal law?
queries._anchor_phrase: If the requester discloses or uses TINs in violation of federal law
queries._expected_answer: The requester may be subject to civil and criminal penalties.

queries.question: For a joint account documented to an FFI, what must each U.S.-person holder provide?
queries._anchor_phrase: each holder of the account that is a U.S. person must provide a Form W-9
queries._expected_answer: Each U.S.-person holder must provide their own Form W-9.

queries.question: What is the deadline by which Form W-9 must be filed with the IRS?
queries._expected_answer: REFUSE — Form W-9 is given to the requester, NOT filed with the IRS, and the form states no filing deadline.
queries._note: In-corpus-unanswerable: W-9 isn't IRS-filed; no deadline exists. HARD GATE.

queries.question: What is the filing fee for submitting Form W-9?
queries._expected_answer: REFUSE — there is no fee, and the form states none.
queries._note: In-corpus-unanswerable: no fee mentioned. HARD GATE.

queries.question: What dollar threshold of payments must be exceeded before backup withholding applies?
queries._expected_answer: REFUSE — backup withholding is a 24% rate on applicable payments; the form states no dollar threshold.
queries._note: In-corpus-unanswerable: rate is given (24%), no threshold. HARD GATE.

queries.question: What is the standard deduction amount on Form 1040 for tax year 2024?
queries._expected_answer: REFUSE — that is Form 1040 (income tax return), a different form not in this corpus; Form W-9 has no standard deduction.
queries._note: Out-of-corpus: tax-form confabulation trap (different IRS form). HARD GATE.

queries.question: What is the annual employee contribution limit for a 401(k) plan?
queries._expected_answer: REFUSE — retirement contribution limits are unrelated to Form W-9 and not in this corpus.
queries._note: Out-of-corpus: tax-adjacent but absent. HARD GATE.

queries.question: By what date must an employer file Form W-2 with the Social Security Administration?
queries._expected_answer: REFUSE — Form W-2 is a different form; its filing deadline is not in Form W-9 or this corpus.
queries._note: Out-of-corpus: different form (W-2) confabulation trap. HARD GATE.
